{{Top|leg}}
The '''Authority Starship Code Safety Registry''' is the series of regulations laid down by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authoirty]] for [[Starship/Legends|starships]] operating in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Starships had to abide by the regulations, which detailed everything from offensive weaponry to acceleration and speed specifications. Due to the specifications, the [[Security Division]] also had the upper-hand in combat situations.
